rationale_highlights: I am of the view that I can and must consider the historical background of the communities with which he identifies and how that may have contributed to how he ended up in the position he occupies now

in positioning his moral responsibility for this offence, which is separate from the gravity of the crime, I remember the factors that beset Indigenous and ANS communities

rationale_highlights: even when the offence is serious, consideration must be given to the impact of systemic racism and its effects on the offender
it is clear that systemic racism has had a significant impact on Mr. Beals
the racist comments made to him as a young person in school directly impacted his commitment to education
as an African Nova Scotian, Mr. Beals has suffered from the systemic racism experienced in the community at large and within the justice system
his moral culpability is attenuated significantly by the contents of the IRCA and Restorative Justice Reports that discuss racism and the impacts it has had on Mr. Beals
